text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in their DM. Moss has six notes, and two of them give ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). The gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't texting bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed the next morning's shift got through the gate.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (no date). Barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on the third shift. The note says it went to second-tier support to test the scanner firmware.

I left out #4409, #4412 and FR-882 from Moss's Central handoffs note because they belong to Central team accounts, not Quarrendon.

I also told Dana about a conflict on #4419. Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 (not one of Moss's) uses the same number for a slow printer at Gate 3. Since the two descriptions don't match, one of them may be wrong, so it's worth checking before it goes in the weekly notes.

All six of Moss's notes are public, so Dana can see everything I used.
